name: mahjong-autotable-mobile
description: Capacitor 6 mobile shell that wraps the mahjong-autotable PWA. See README.md for the operator runbook.

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
